newsitem.title: USA: Emerson Radio says to pursue claims.
newsitem.headline: Emerson Radio says to pursue claims.

text.p: Emerson Radio Corp said on Wednesday that it will pursue its claims against International Jensen Inc and Recoton Corp, regarding International Jensen and Recoton's merger.

Emerson Radio said the majority of International Jensen shares not held by chairman and chief executive Robert Shaw and William Blair Leveraged Capital Fund LP either voted against the merger or abstained. Shaw and Blair own 37 percent and 26 percent of International Jensen, respectively.
Emerson Radio said its offer to purchase Jensen was superior to Recoton's offer.
International Jensen and Recoton were not immediately available for comment.
